simple: **NABARD** began with the **CRAFICARD** committee (30 March 1979, B. Sivaraman). It was created by **Act 61 of 1981** and started on **12 July 1982**. It is now fully owned by the Government of India.
It has three kinds of functions: **financial** (refinance, RIDF, LTIF, PMAY-G), **developmental** (cooperatives, SHG-Bank Linkage, RSETIs) and **supervision** (StCBs, DCCBs, RRBs).
NABARD is the only **National Implementing Entity** in India for the **Adaptation Fund** (July 2012) and also for **NAFCC**.
An **NBFC** lends and invests like a bank but cannot take **demand deposits**, is not in the payment system and has no **DICGC** cover.
Some firms are not registered by RBI because another regulator handles them: **SEBI, IRDA, NHB, MCA** or the **State Governments**.
**Chit funds** are run under a State-administered Act. **CIS** is regulated by **SEBI**. **MLM, pyramid and Ponzi** schemes are banned by the **1978 Act**.
terms: CRAFICARD
The committee that reviewed institutional credit for agriculture and rural development; it led to NABARD.
ARDC
Agricultural Refinance and Development Corporation; its refinance functions went to NABARD.
SHG Bank Linkage Project
NABARD's 1992 project linking self-help groups to banks; called the world's largest microfinance project.
Refinance
NABARD's support to banks and other eligible lenders so they can lend to rural borrowers.
RIDF
Rural Infrastructure Development Fund; a direct finance route for rural infrastructure.
NIE
National Implementing Entity: a national body recognised by the Adaptation Fund Board that meets its fiduciary standards.
NAFCC
National Adaptation Fund for Climate Change (August 2015), meeting adaptation costs of vulnerable States and UTs.
NBFC
A company that does loans, securities, leasing, hire-purchase, insurance or chit business, but not mainly farming, industry, trade or property.
NOF
Net Owned Funds; an NBFC needs Rs 2 crore (since April 1999) to be registered.
RNBC
Residuary Non-Banking Company; its principal business is receiving deposits under any scheme.
Systemically important NBFC
An NBFC with assets of Rs 500 crore or more (older RBI classification).
CIC
Core Investment Company; an NBFC that holds shares and securities of group companies.
NOFHC
Non-Operative Financial Holding Company; the vehicle for a promoter group to set up a new bank.
ROSCA
Rotating Savings and Credit Association; the chit fund is its Indian version.
CIS
Collective Investment Scheme; money pooled for units, such as time-share in resorts. Regulated by SEBI.
Ponzi scheme
High-return promises paid out of new depositors' money, with no asset creation.
13.remember: NABARD looks after the village and supervises rural banks; RBI watches NBFCs and deposits; everyone else is watched by SEBI, the States or other named regulators.

traps.t: An NBFC is not a bank
traps.d: An NBFC cannot accept demand deposits, is not part of the payment and settlement system and cannot issue cheques drawn on itself. Its depositors have no DICGC cover.
traps.r: Rule: lends like a bank, but all three banking features are missing.

traps.t: Chit funds are not regulated by RBI
traps.d: The Chit Funds Act 1982 is a Central Act administered by State Governments. A chit subscription is not a deposit. RBI's only hook is the ban on chit funds accepting deposits (2009).
traps.r: Rule: chit funds = State Governments; RBI only has the deposit ban.

traps.d: The Adaptation Fund has its HQ in Washington, USA, and the Green Climate Fund has its HQ in Songdo, Incheon, Republic of Korea.
traps.r: Rule: Adaptation Fund = Washington; GCF = Songdo, Korea.

traps.d: Section 35(6) of the Banking Regulation Act 1949 lets NABARD inspect StCBs, DCCBs and RRBs. Section 45-IA of the RBI Act 1934 is the NBFC registration rule.
traps.r: Rule: 35(6) = NABARD inspects rural banks; 45-IA = NBFC registration.

traps.d: This handout makes a systemically important NBFC Rs 500 crore. Chapter 7 (scale-based regulation, 2022) puts the Base Layer at non-deposit NBFCs below Rs 1,000 crore.
traps.r: Rule: use the figure that matches the wording of the question; the older NBFC-ND-SI wording means Rs 500 crore.

traps.d: The handout says the Adaptation Fund was established in 2001 and launched in 2007 at CoP 7, Marrakech. The year and the CoP number do not obviously match.
traps.r: Rule: use the wording only if an option repeats it; check the COP numbering in your notebook.
